summary.text:
• Brewers ace Jacob Misiorowski left World Series Game 5 in the sixth inning with a leg cramp. Rookie Cooper Pratt set a record.
• NBA: Cade Cunningham scored 30 to lead the Pistons past the Hornets 97-89. Tyrese Maxey's 27 points lifted the 76ers over the Pacers 114-109. The Raptors routed the Magic 129-99.
• Giannis Antetokounmpo earned his first win with the Heat, 129-117 over the Hawks. Bam Adebayo passed Udonis Haslem as Miami's career rebounding leader.
• Timberwolves' Anthony Edwards will miss up to two months with injury.
